summary: Renders Huffman-decoded audio/VQ samples into an interleaved 16-bit word output buffer (a4) as part of the Bitstream_Texture_Decompression ABI. Reads codebook selector entries from a6, decodes Huffman bit symbols from the input bitstream (buffer this[2345], bit cursor this[2346]) using the dword_5B4788 Huffman decode table, scales via the dword_5DA738 scale table against a2, and writes three interleaved output words per subband while advancing a5 by three codebook indices. Zero-fills unused mono and stereo output slots based on subband count this[2350] and the stereo flag this[2355].

operations.description: If the subband/granule count this[2350] (0x24B8) is <= 0, skip the entire decode loop.
Main subband loop: the output cursor v9 walks the a4 word buffer three interleaved slots per subband; loop counter v31 is compared against this[2350] to terminate.
Read the next bitstream byte at a3; if zero, emit three zero words into the current subband slots (*(v9-32)=0, v9[32]=0, v9[96]=0) without decoding.
Stereo branch: when this[2355] (0x24CC) == 2, decode using the stereo codebook path (entry into LABEL_12); the != 2 path skips the extra stereo reads.
Read the Huffman code length v20 from the bitstream byte at a3 and fetch the codebook entry a6[2*v20] (bit length v21) and a6[2*v20+1] (scale index v34).
Perform Huffman bit reads from the bitstream: dword_5B4788[v21] masked against a byteswapped dword at ((this[2346] >> 3) + this[2345]) shifted right by -(v21 + (this[2346] & 7)).
Advance the bitstream cursor this[2346] (0x24A8) by the consumed Huffman code length v21 after each symbol read.

Negative-scale path: compute sample = (v37 * (v34 + v22)) >> 12 using the codebook value from a2 + 4*(*a5 + (v21 << 6)) and write it into the three interleaved output words (*(v9-32), v9[32], v9[96]).
Non-negative-scale path: look up the scale offset v27 = dword_5DA738[v34], read a byte-triple codebook offset from v27 + 3*v26, fetch three samples from a2 at *a5 + (byte << 6), and store them >> 12.
Loop tail: advance the codebook index pointer a5 by 3, the output cursor v9, the counter v31, and skip a6 by 2*(1 << v30) per bit-width v30; continue while v31 < this[2350].
After the loop, zero-fill the unused mono output words (a4[128..191], a4[64..127], a4[0..63] as needed) via a switch on this[2350] dispatched through the jump table jpt_530C9D.
If this[2355] == 2, zero-fill the unused stereo-channel output words via a second switch on this[2350] dispatched through the jump table jpt_530EF8.
